summary: Full-width hero slider with two height options, usable as single banner.
features: Separate alignment controls for mobile and desktop
Rich content options including captions, flags, headings, and buttons
Background media support with overlay and fallback color
shortDescription: The Basic Hero Slider creates impactful full-width hero areas typically placed at the top of homepages or landing pages. It supports multiple slides or can function as a single hero banner. Each slide includes content options like captions, flags, headings, sublines, and buttons with customizable colors. Background media (images or video) supports overlay effects and fallback colors. Navigation positioning automatically follows content alignment, which is configured separately for mobile and desktop breakpoints.
